title: Final velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the ambulance's uniform velocity as 20 m/s using v = a × t₁.

title: Final distance value
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the ambulance's distance from the starting point when the siren stops as 680 m.

title: Motion phase analysis
description: Important: The student must correctly model the ambulance's motion in two phases: uniformly accelerated until t₁, then uniform motion.

title: Sound travel time setup
description: Important: The student must establish that the sound travels back to the starting point, relating ambulance position to sound travel time via v₀.

title: Equation system construction
description: Important: The student must set up simultaneous equations for the ambulance's position and the sound's travel distance.

title: Time interval definition
description: Optional: The student clearly defines Δt as the uniform motion time before the siren stops, or equivalent time variable.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student verifies all quantities have consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in time
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly calculates the sound travel time as (t₂ - t₁) instead of accounting for Δt properly.

title: Acceleration phase omission
description: Pitfall: The student neglects the ambulance's accelerated motion phase when calculating its final position.
